example.el: Όταν ήμουν μιτσής, έμενα με τη γιαγιά μου στη Λεμεσό.
example.en: When I was little, I lived with my grandmother in Limassol.

why: Example illustrated only the youth-slang sense (my girlfriend), not the first sense 'small, little'.

example.el: Ο παππούς μου ήταν βλάχος από το Μέτσοβο.
example.en: My grandfather was a Vlach from Metsovo.

why: Example illustrated only the offensive sense (boor), not the first sense 'Vlach, Aromanian'.
